script.title: DINO PARTY ROOM FOR TWELVE
script.scene_zh: 親子場館 · 預約派對
script.story_hook: Marco books a dino party room for Eli.
script.intro_zh: 馬可為兒子伊萊預約一間恐龍主題的生日派對教室。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Today: booking a birthday party room.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來！今天要預約一間生日派對教室。
script.outro: Party booked, cake plans set. See you at the next one!
script.outro_zh: 派對訂好了，蛋糕也安排妥當。下一集再見！
script.practice_intro_en: Time to repeat the party-booking phrases together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 一起跟讀預約派對會用到的句子吧。
script.char_a_description: a young father in his early thirties, short curly black hair with a thin beard, an orange button-down shirt, dark jeans, brown sneakers, stocky build, holding a folded shopping list.
script.char_b_description: a perky woman in her late twenties, straight blonde hair cut in a chin-length bob, a pink polo shirt with a tiny logo, black leggings, colorful sneakers, slim build, wearing a big friendly smile.
script.youtube_title: 【建議收藏】🎂幫孩子訂生日派對，60句美式聽力｜人數限制、訂金刷卡全聽懂｜家長必學🌱Booking a Party Room💪
script.youtube_title_en: "Two O'Clock Is Actually Perfect" - Booking a Birthday Party Room
script.youtube_description:
想幫小孩訂生日派對，卻不知道英文怎麼開口？
這段 60 句對話帶你走進親子場館的櫃台：從約時段、問人數上限，到花生禁令、防滑襪、付訂金刷卡，句句都能直接套用。
你會聽到：
🎧 預約開場："I'd like to book a party room."
🎧 確認規定："Can we bring our own cake?"
🎧 付款完成："Oh, it went through! Did you see that?"
🎧 臨別道謝："You've thought of everything, honestly."
後半段為逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，先聽懂、再跟著說，越練越順。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
每天一段生活英文，讓你的耳朵先學會。
喜歡請訂閱、按讚並開啟小鈴鐺，下一集見！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: Need to book a kids' party in English? Follow Marco as he reserves a dinosaur-themed birthday room at a family venue. In 60 natural lines you will hear how to ask about guest limits, outside food rules, grip socks, and deposits. A tricky payment moment turns out fine, and every phrase is useful for real life. The second half is a sentence-by-sentence listen-and-repeat workout. Made for A2 learners who want practical American English. Listen first, speak later, no memorizing. Subscribe for a new dialogue every week. #EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧預約派對英文｜問人數・講規定・付訂金｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🎧60句聽力跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
小朋友的生日派對，想用英文訂場地，該從哪裡問起？
人數、食物規定、訂金怎麼付，每一句你都聽得懂嗎？
這一集帶大家走進親子活動場館，看馬可幫兒子伊萊預訂恐龍主題派對房，從挑時段、問規定，到刷卡付訂金、確認當天流程。
你會聽到：
🎧 預約開場："Hi! I'd like to book a party room." 一句話講清你的需求。
🎧 人數上限："Our cap is fifteen children, so fine." 有沒有超過限制立刻知道。
🎧 食物規定："One rule: no peanut snacks, okay?" 過敏相關的重要提醒。
🎧 付款確認："Yep, I see a pending charge now." 刷卡成功原來這樣說。
後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60 個句子先聽一遍、再跟著說一遍，從耳朵一路練到嘴巴。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。句型聽熟了，輪到你自然會開口。
祝每個小朋友都有一場難忘的生日派對。
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a dinosaur party flyer at the counter

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! I'd like to book a party room.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈpɑɹi ɹum/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我想預約一間派對教室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great! Who's the party for?
dialogue.zh: 太好了！是幫誰慶生？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My son Eli. He turns seven next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ sɑn ˈiˌlaɪ hi tɜɹnz ˈsɛvən nɛkst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 我兒子伊萊，他下個月滿七歲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Happy early birthday! When do you want it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæpi ˈɜɹli ˈbɜɹθˌdeɪ wɛn du ju wɑnt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 提前祝他生日快樂！你們想辦哪一天？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday, June sixth, if that works.
dialogue.zh: 如果可以，六月六號星期六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the calendar... hmm.
dialogue.zh: 我查一下行事曆……嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is something wrong?
dialogue.zh: 有什麼問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Noon is full, but two o'clock opens.
dialogue.phonetic: /nun ɪz fʊl bʌt tu əˈklɑk ˈoʊpənz/
dialogue.zh: 中午訂滿了，但兩點還有空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two o'clock is actually perfect.
dialogue.zh: 兩點剛剛好，其實完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Love that. How many kids are coming?
dialogue.phonetic: /lʌv ðæt haʊ ˈmɛni kɪdz ɑɹ ˈkʌmɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！預計幾個小朋友來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve kids, plus a few parents.
dialogue.zh: 十二個小孩，再加幾位家長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our cap is fifteen children, so fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊɹ kæp ɪz ˈfɪftin ˈtʃɪldɹənz soʊ faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我們的上限是十五個孩子，沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Can we bring our own cake?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl kæn wi bɹɪŋ aʊɹ aʊn keɪk/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我們可以自帶蛋糕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, no cake fee at all.
dialogue.zh: 可以，帶蛋糕不用額外收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, my mom bakes it herself.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我媽媽自己烤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice! One rule: no peanut snacks, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs wʌn ɹul noʊ ˈpinət snæks oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不過有一條規定：不可以帶花生零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. No peanuts. Good to know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑ ɪt noʊ ˈpinəts ɡʊd tə noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，不帶花生。還好您提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some kids in our groups have allergies.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm kɪdz ɪn aʊɹ ɡɹups hæv əˈlɜɹdʒiz/
dialogue.zh: 有些參加活動的孩子有過敏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That makes total sense.
dialogue.zh: 這樣說非常有道理。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, the fun part: which theme?
dialogue.zh: 接下來是好玩的部分：要選哪個主題？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, he's crazy about dinosaurs.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，他超迷恐龍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dino room is our favorite with kids.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdaɪnoʊ ɹum ɪz aʊɹ ˈfeɪvɚɪt wɪð kɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 恐龍主題房最受小朋友歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sold! What's included in the room?
dialogue.zh: 就訂它！這間包含哪些項目？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours, decorations, and a game leader.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊɚz ˌdɛkəˈɹeʃənz ænd ə ɡeɪm ˈlidɚ/
dialogue.zh: 兩小時場地、裝飾佈置，還有一位遊戲帶領人員。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the pizza party included too?
dialogue.zh: 披薩餐也包含在內嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pepperoni or cheese, kid's choice.
dialogue.zh: 有的，辣香腸披薩或起司披薩，小朋友自己選。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheese, please. He's a picky eater.
dialogue.zh: 起司披薩。他的嘴很挑剔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart call. Socks are required on the slides.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt kɔl sɑks ɑɹ ɹɪˈkwaɪɚd ɑn ðə slaɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 明智。滑滑梯區一定要穿襪子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Regular socks or grippy ones?
dialogue.zh: 一般襪子可以嗎，還是要防滑襪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grippy socks, four dollars per pair.
dialogue.zh: 要防滑襪，一雙四塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll buy fresh pairs for everyone.
dialogue.zh: 我們會幫每個孩子買新的一雙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's smart. Anything else so far?
dialogue.zh: 很聰明。目前還有其他問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can grandma take photos during the party?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ˈɡɹænmɑ teɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz ˈdʊɹɪŋ ðə ˈpɑɹi/
dialogue.zh: 阿嬤可以在派對中拍照嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! Tripods are a no, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs ˈtraɪˌpɑdz ɑɹ ə noʊ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以！不過不準用三角架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood. She'll just use her phone.
dialogue.zh: 了解，她只會拿手機拍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, a two-hundred deposit holds it.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə tu ˈhʌndɪd dɪˈpɑzɪt hoʊldz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，兩百塊訂金就能保留時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hundred? Can we pay by card?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndɪd kæn wi peɪ baɪ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 兩百？可以刷卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Card, cash, or app, whatever's easy.
dialogue.zh: 信用卡、現金或行動支付都收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... my wallet app is being weird today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ ˈwɑlɪt æp ɪz ˈbiɪŋ wɪɹd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯……我的錢包 App 今天有點問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No stress. You can pay right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ stɹɛs ju kæn peɪ raɪt hiɹ/
dialogue.zh: 別緊張，在這裡直接付就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, it went through! Did you see that?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɪt wɛnt θɹu dɪd ju si ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 咦，剛剛好像扣款成功了！您看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, I see a pending charge now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp aɪ si ə ˈpɛndɪŋ tʃɑɹdʒ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，有一筆待入帳的款項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. When should we show up that day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wɛn ʃʊd wi ʃoʊ ʌp ðæt deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好！活動當天我們要幾點到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes early for setup.
dialogue.zh: 請提前二十分鐘進來佈置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we bring candles and plates?
dialogue.zh: 蠟燭和盤子要自己帶嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plates and cups are on us, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪts ænd kʌps ɑɹ ɑn ʌs ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 盤子和杯子其實由我們提供。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's so helpful. Anything from home?
dialogue.zh: 太有用了！還需要自帶別的東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A towel for our big water slide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaʊəl fɔɹ aʊɹ bɪɡ ˈwɔɾɚ slaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 要帶一條毛巾，玩水滑梯時會濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A towel, got it. He will be so happy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaʊəl ɡɑ ɪt hi wɪl bi soʊ ˈhæpi/
dialogue.zh: 毛巾，記下了。他一定會開心到不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why we love this job.
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們最喜歡這份工作的原因。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I text you if plans change?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ tɛkst ju ɪf plænz tʃeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 如果時間有變，我可以傳訊息給您嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this is my direct number.
dialogue.zh: 好的，這是我的直撥專線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if it rains, we're indoors, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ɪt reɪnz wɪɹ ɪnˈdɔɹz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 還有，如果下雨，我們還是在室內，對嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fully indoor, rain or shine.
dialogue.zh: 全程都在室內，不管下雨或大太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've thought of everything, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 說實話，您什麼都想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: June sixth, two o'clock, dino room.
dialogue.zh: 六月六號，兩點，恐龍主題房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Confirmed! Thank you so much.
dialogue.zh: 確認！真的非常感謝您。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure, and happy birthday, Eli!
dialogue.zh: 我的榮幸，也祝伊萊生日快樂！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you in June. Have a good one!
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ɪn dʒun hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 六月見，祝您今天過得愉快！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye-bye, and text me anytime.
dialogue.zh: 再見，隨時傳訊息給我喔！
